fixes.what: The Romanian contest and occupation of 1919-1920 are drawn on the wrong land: the region spec lands in Slovakia and Ruthenia, not in Hungary east of the Tisza and around Budapest as the text says.
fixes.why: The spec {minus:[Hungarian Republic 1919, Hungarian Republic 1920]} resolves to 116 cells (29,195 km2): 53 in Ukraine (Ruthenia), 34 in Slovakia, 9 in Hungary, 0 in Romania; the 1920 shape holds 35 cells within 60 km of Debrecen that the spec leaves out. Hungarian-Romanian War page: 'On the evening of 1 May, the entire east bank of the Tisza River was under the control of the Romanian Army'; 'Romania occupied all of Hungary except for an area around Lake Balaton'; 'In early 1920, Romanian troops departed Hungary'. The 1919 keyframe note says the occupation is to be drawn from the ledger, so the 1920 anchor would hatch Czechoslovak Slovakia and Ruthenia and leave Hungary proper clear.
fixes.fix: Contest 1919/4-1919/8 ('the entire east bank of the Tisza'): {"intersect":[{"cliopatria":"Hungarian Republic","year":1920},{"union":[{"admin1":"Hajdú-Bihar","country":"Hungary"},{"admin1":"Szabolcs-Szatmár-Bereg","country":"Hungary"},{"admin1":"Békés","country":"Hungary"}]}]} (resolves to 58 cells, 14,876 km2; add the parts of Csongrád and Jász-Nagykun-Szolnok east of the river if wanted). Occupation 1919/8-1920 ('all of Hungary except for an area around Lake Balaton'): {"minus":[{"cliopatria":"Hungarian Republic","year":1920},{"lon":17.75,"lat":46.85,"km":60}]}. Use the same specs in the war zone.
